description: This file contains CMake functions and scripts for configuring and installing header-only libraries and packages, including generating configuration files and package configuration files.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a header-only library, generating CMake config files and handling dependencies.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a package configuration file, generating a .pc file with appropriate include and library paths.
